notes.title: Exciting news from the TMG team!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers,[/h1][p][/p][h3]We have exciting news![/h3][p]Both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] have received brand-new updates! These patches focus on quality-of-life improvements, making it easier and smoother than ever to step back into the cold, mysterious halls where your journey began. From technical fixes to subtle polish, these updates breathe fresh life into the first two games of the series. Perfect if you’ve been thinking of revisiting the adventure or introducing a new partner to where it all started. [/p][p][/p][h3]But that’s not all… [/h3][p]We’re thrilled to announce that both [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] are now available on Nintendo Switch! 🎉 This marks a whole new way to explore the Antarctic mysteries with your partner, no matter where your adventures take you. [/p][previewyoutube="MUn4X9HajDI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]And we’re not stopping there:[/b] [i]We Were Here Together[/i] is also on the way for Switch, planned to release on [b]October 9th.[/b] Alongside this, it will receive its very own quality-of-life update, bringing the same improvements that our earlier entries just received. [/p][p][/p][h3]For our Explorers attending the Tokyo Game Show next week: come find us! [/h3][p]We’ll be at the show with We Were Here goodies, friendly faces from the dev team, and plenty to chat about regarding the past, present, and future of the series. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5c296fc7e04e817d500e2702b6d3e4da13fc00fa.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you, Explorers, for all your support and enthusiasm! [/h3][p]It’s because of you that the We Were Here journey continues to grow across more platforms and adventures. Whether you’re returning to the frozen halls or stepping into them for the first time, remember: the only way out… is together. [/p][p][/p][h3]— Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Explorers,[/h2][p][/p][p]Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.[/p][p]For years, the [i]We Were Here[/i] series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).[/p][p]To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, [i]We Were Here[/i] games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.[/p][p]If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:[/p][p]You’re never truly alone…[/p][p][/p][h3]See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b][/h3]

tags.feature: We’re super excited to announce that [i]We Were Here[/i], [i]We Were Here Too[/i], and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] are coming to Nintendo Switch!

notes.title: Happy Holidays Explorers!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Ho, ho, ho, Explorers! 🎄[/h2]

[b]The holidays are here, and from everyone at Total Mayhem Games, we wish you happy holidays and all the best for 2025![/b] It’s been quite the year! Maybe a quiet one on the surface, but trust us, behind the scenes at our Rotterdam base camp, it’s been anything but. We’ve been hard at work preparing for the adventures to come, and we’re thrilled to head into the new year with all of you by our side.

But what’s a holiday season without a little something to unwrap? 🎁 We’re kicking things off with a [b]6-day advent calendar[/b] (in full We Were Here style, of course)!

[h2]🎶 Day 1: Cozy Lo-Fi Tunes for Every Explorer[/h2]

We’re starting things off with a musical treat! If you’ve seen the [url=https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o][b]YouTube video[/b][/url] featuring remixes of the original We Were Here soundtracks in lo-fi style, you already know the vibe. As of today, you can also find them on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6JOpn6nak2HJCajID9w2Lu?si=mCSsCCMlSP2eSkMVZYnfFw][b]Spotify[/b][/url]. Whether you’re studying, commuting, or just relaxing by the fire, these tunes will bring some Antarctic calm to your day. 🎧

[previewyoutube=UFM6xBz_18o;full]https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o[/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ What’s Next? Stay Tuned![/h2]

[b]Over the next five days, we’ll be revealing a new surprise each day.[/b] A little spoiler? Some seriously cool merch featuring brand-new artwork has just dropped. If you can’t wait, you can sneak a peek [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/]here[/url]. Otherwise, [b]keep an eye on our [url=https://linktr.ee/WeWereHereSeries]socials[/url] and let the surprises unfold!
[/b]
[h2]Christmas at Base Camp 🎅[/h2]

For those craving a festive co-op adventure, [b]we’ve brought back the holiday-themed puzzle at base camp in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900]We Were Here Together![/url][/b] Grab your favorite Explorer, whip up some hot cocoa, and dive in for some wintry fun.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Winter Sale Alert![/h2]

Oh, and don’t forget: the Steam Winter Sale is live now, and the [b]We Were Here games are available with some sweet discounts.[/b] If there’s a game missing from your collection (or you want to gift one to a friend), now’s the perfect time to grab it. Check out the deals:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/677160/We_Were_Here_Too/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip/?curator_clanid=33033900

[h3]Stay warm, stay adventurous, and enjoy the holidays!
— The Total Mayhem Games Team
[/h3]

notes.title: An Expedition awaits you!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

A new bite-sized adventure awaits you; [i]We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip[/i] is [b]available now[/b]!

[previewyoutube=aPHRenQug3g;full][/previewyoutube]

In this new bite-sized series of the main [i]We Were Here[/i] series, You and your partner play as a team of Explorers on a boat, hearing a distress call that might be familiar to some of you. Eager to answer the call, you try to locate the sound, but end up on a deserted island with an amusement park?! 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png[/img][/url]

And the best part, you put your friendship to the test for [b]free[/b] until [b]October 13[/b], so be sure that you and your bff (or are they?) have claimed the game before this date. It will be yours forever to keep. And it doesn’t matter which platform you and partner will play on, as the game is [b]playable cross platform[/b]! So you can truly test your friendship across platforms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip&utm_source=SteamHubT&utm_medium=StLink&utm_campaign=FShipLCH

This game is a great introduction for new Explorers to the series, as well serving as a fun friendship test for you and your co-op partner. Who knows, maybe you can finally work on your Communication, Teamwork and Trust skills amongst each other, something you definitely need for our main games. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/a6a8784b44876221d4b4f5d944e3e15812bef17d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/a6a8784b44876221d4b4f5d944e3e15812bef17d.gif[/img][/url]

[h2] Ready for Forever? [/h2]

Feel like you and your partner are now ready to dive (back) into the full experience? To celebrate the release of [i]We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip[/i], our latest main-series game [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] will be available with a [b]35% discount[/b] at 7PM CEST.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h3]<3 Total Mayhem Games[/h3]

notes.title: Together for Christmas
notes.content:
Dear explorers !

It's almost Christmas time! And we got just the experience and fun times for you! 

[h2]Celebrating Christmas Together[/h2]

The base camp in [i]We Were Here Together[/i] is all ready for Christmas celebrations! However, not everything it just a jolly good time, your help is needed !

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/ad535f194392a3ff7fb0f8856b6a8e5a282b8061.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/ad535f194392a3ff7fb0f8856b6a8e5a282b8061.jpg[/img][/url]

Hidden away at your basecamp is a special puzzle with an ‘enlightening’ reward that will really get the celebrations started! This puzzle won’t be out there forever, so be sure to participate in this festive mind breaker before the end of [b]January 5th.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/

Additionally, you can now get our newest game [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] with a [b]20%[/b] discount! Be sure to continue your adventure on the cold Antartic in our 4th game in the series! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h2]12 Days of Christmas[/h2]

On our [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]Twitter page[/url], we've been hosting a 12 Days of Christmas giveaway ! These will run until [b]tomorrow (23rd)[/b], so be sure to participate while you still can !

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/c24b9360bfd0c7189a70265de8eaf764d02fc444.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/c24b9360bfd0c7189a70265de8eaf764d02fc444.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Together Forever[/h2]

One of the most important thing for us, is the way that our games bring people together. Forge new friendships and bonds, learning more about each other and create ever lasting memories. For many, the Holiday season is a special time of the year to do the same in real life.

But we also know that this doesn't go for everyone. The wonderful people at Samaritants help those who are struggling during times like these. They have a special campaign Stream [url=https://www.samaritans.org/support-us/events-and-fundraising/stream-for-samaritans/]for Samaritans: Night Shift Before Christmas[/url], which is a special charity event combined with streaming to help people who struggle with loneliness and depression during Christmas. We're honoured to have We Were Here Forever as part of this campaign. More info and options to donate can be found here.

[h2]Total Comfiness[/h2]

Many of us are relaxing during their Christmas break. Binging a movie series, playing some boargames, finally reading that one book - just having a good time. What better way to do this with some comfy clothing! We got some merch for you all that will do just that! Click [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/category/new]here[/url] to be redirected to our merch store. Maybe you'll find more things you like.

[h1]We wish you all a happy 2023![/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/96b43dda92bacbbdb59cac41c9a384ee520a7b03.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/96b43dda92bacbbdb59cac41c9a384ee520a7b03.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Exciting news from the Antarctic: new game announced!
notes.content:
Surprise dear explorers!

We’re happy to announce that the 4th game in the We Were Here series is coming to you in 2021! 

[previewyoutube=34R0UCd493M;full][/previewyoutube]

In [i]We Were Here Forever[/i], we’re going to bring you explorers a next level experience! Expect an even more intriguing and exciting environment for you to explore with new cooperative puzzles and challenges for you and your partner to unravel. Forever will be the largest and most lively game ever seen in the Series, and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.

There is much more to discover in the cold of the Antarctic. One cannot help but wonder what happened to those explorers who got left behind and..

[i][b]does one ever escape Castle Rock??[/b][/i]

[h2]Your wait will not be forever[/h2]

We’re sure that you guys want to get your hands on the new game in the We Were Here Series just as much as we would like to hand it to you!

Please be patient, our team is still busy torturing each other by testing the puzzles, making the game even look prettier and spookier, and overall, just being excited for this game. We promise it’s not going to take forever - we’re aiming to bring you the game later this year! 

For now, we hope you enjoyed our announcement trailer and it got you excited enough to wishlist the game on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever]right here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/26b93771fe212872b3893cebf235fabe0de500e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]You Were There for updates[/h2]

If you want to make sure you don’t miss any updates on the game’s release, be sure you follow us on Twitter and join the lore discussions with fellow explorers on [url=https://discord.gg/Pr72dKUFdK]Discord[/url]!

You’ll be able to discuss anything related to our games, find new friends to play with or just generally hang out and have a good time!

We love to hear what you guys think of We Were Here Forever, so please be sure to share your thoughts with us!

Yours Forever,

[b]Total Mayhem Games [/b]

notes.title: We Are Here to reconnect you with your loved ones
notes.content:
[h2]Be Here Together, with our [strike]Lockdown[/strike] Valentine’s Package[/h2]
This weekend is Valentine’s Day, the day of love and appreciation. Unfortunately, many of us might not be able to see our loved ones due to the current state of the world. We hope to bring people together, providing a fun and exciting experience where teamwork is key. Additionally, we’ve prepared a special [url=https://totalmayhemgames.com/valentines-carepackage/]Valentine’s Package[/url] for everyone to use. Behind that link you can find special wallpapers for your phone and/or desktop, our soundtracks, streamer kits, and last but not least - romantic and fun Valentine ecards to send to your loved ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/ce9d8abf9788a232c0f8fdc7177282567a8c952d.png[/img]

💌Tweeting explorers, can we have your attention please? This year we’re playing cupid (or mailman…)! Send that special explorer a card via us and they might win one of our prices! Enter our raffle and who knows, you guys might win our games on either PC, Xbox or PlayStation! [url=https://forms.gle/kuHrZUsEC6dxzB5a9]Click here to enter our raffle[/url]💌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/d8ab5b5a8298a3f12facd49ae0895e9fd68bd451.png[/img]

[b]We Were Here… and now We Are On PlayStation![/b]
💙SURPRISE!!!💙 
It’s been three years since the We Were Here Series came to life, and today marks the day we bring it to PlayStation! [i]We Were Here[/i] will be [b]free[/b] to play until February 22nd, and the release of [i]We Were Here Too[/i] and [i]We Were Here Together[/i] will follow on the 23rd. 

[previewyoutube=cjoAQOTGHQY;full]https://youtu.be/cjoAQOTGHQY[/previewyoutube]

So if you’ve been dying to play the game (again) or want to take the chance to connect with a friend or family member who only plays console games, now is your chance! 

[previewyoutube=7CZF9Uj2jH8;full][Podcast][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Signal detected! New update released!
notes.content:
[h1]Setting new frequencies[/h1]
As you may have noticed, we have updated We Were Here on Steam! This patch implements a new voice-chat system called Vivox. This should improve communication between explorers using their walkie-talkies, especially those trapped in Castle Rock!
You also might notice that when booting up We Were Here Too, the main menu has received a bit of a facelift! Not only is it looking better, it will also keep you up to date with what’s going on with the We Were Here Series… speaking of which… 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/cd02464d9fc598b8de38a48e07959448b39e4021.jpg[/img]
[h2]Wear it like you mean it[/h2]
We have opened up our brand new merchandise store! There is an even better way to explore Castle Rock when you look the part with your co-op partner! There are different lines of designs, like our simple yet straightforward [b]TMG Essentials[/b] designs. Our [b]TMG FOR FRIENDS[/b] is there for those who want to relive those memories of being trapped and spending a lot of valuable time together. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/5c7a2d1342c730cc769b100bed398427537c3a0f.png[/img]
But there is [b]limited[/b] merchandise as well! Such as [b]Curse of Castle Rock[/b] pieces of merch as well as [b]Holiday[/b]-related sweaters to keep you and your co-op partner warm!  These lines of merchandise are available until January 31st! 

Can’t wait to get your own merch? Go to http://www.totalmayhemmerch.com
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/773fbc1acfbc56f922c97fbd755a3c7efa2a8238.png[/img]
[h2]Ho Ho Hold on![/h2]
The explorers sure like to celebrate whenever there is a good occasion to do so! If you explore the basecamp in [b]We Were Here Together[/b], you might find them eating some treats based on a Dutch tradition called ‘Sinterklaas’. Can you find all of them? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/8d25191f160e039e2486f4ae5607053ca9484050.gif[/img]
There’s also a door on the basecamp that’s yet to be opened… I wonder if there’s something lurking behind that as well… 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/8c5368d9173a8a79f0b172e05c13a014fcf0929a.png[/img]
That’s all for now, over and out!

notes.title: Halloween in Castle Rock!
notes.content:
Can you imagine carving out pumpkins and watching some scary movies? There’s no time for that, because you and your co-op partner must return to Castle Rock!  [b]We Were Here Too[/b] is [b]-55% off[/b] during the Steam Halloween Sale, so there is no better time to explore and survive together!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/677160/We_Were_Here_Too/
If you’re already in a ‘spooktober’ mood, make sure to pick up the [b]soundtrack[/b] of each entry in the series who are also on a [b]50% discount[/b]! Speaking of the series, did you know that the sequel to We Were Here Too, which is called [b]We Were Here Together[/b] is also on sale? You might even find some Halloween decorations in the basecamp of the explorers if you get it now for [b]-30% off[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/04acf01dd4159622457eef4b4e78baa9835c6282.jpg[/img]
 [h2]There once was a castle filled with life…[/h2]
...and now it seems they have all moved to Discord! The official We Were Here Discord server is growing with new explorers joining every day! Looking for a co-op partner, want to theorise about the mysteries of Castle Rock or do you just want to hang out in our digital hot chocolate bar? Join our Discord server today! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/a7f3853d55665fe7c1301531144f25d8b5561a5c.png[/img]
There’s also a monthly challenge for the community which could be a puzzle, news related to the series or a contest! For this spooky month, we asked our lovely community imagine the explorers in their worst nightmare, community member ‘Duskinator’ did an awesome job! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/7e560264636c2da768a36255ab744759b3bd49bc.png[/img]
[h2]Cross, Circle, Triangle, Square?[/h2]
We are also very excited to have shared the news recently that [b]the We Were Here series is coming to PlayStation 4[/b]! We can’t wait to have the exciting PlayStation community join our mysterious puzzle adventures and co-op shenanigans. That's all for now... 

[h3]Have a happy Halloween![/h3]

notes.title: September News
notes.content:
How is everyone doing? It's been a busy month but we've been making steady progress. In fact, we can finally reveal some exciting news... at the end of this post ;)

[h2]What are we up to right now?[/h2]
We can tell you that we're participating in the Tokyo Game Show this year, with some awesome news! If you aren't following the event, you can find it at the end of this post as well. The Tokyo Game Show is always an exciting event with some big announcements and trailers to enjoy - and we're always curious to see what's popular in other parts of the world. We'd love to attract new [i]We Were Here[/i] fans from Japan and Asia more generally! If you'd like to check out the event yourself, Inverse has [url=https://www.inverse.com/gaming/tokyo-game-show-tgs-2020-schedule-square-enix-capcom-sega]a nice article on how and when to watch.[/url]

Which announcements are you hyped for?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c8770ca14f756f6dc13d55ce172eb78b0d78f3e7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c8770ca14f756f6dc13d55ce172eb78b0d78f3e7.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]How the show looked in years past. It's all online for 2020.[/i]

[h2]Are you a notetaker? [/h2]
Some of the puzzles in our games can be more easily solved with the aid of pen and paper, as player QAQAQAQAQ has discovered. Some great drawings here!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/4e6b96b67778b0891512728e511e4130e94a80d4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/4e6b96b67778b0891512728e511e4130e94a80d4.jpg[/img][/url]

We're pleased to see people taking notes, because the We Were Here series is inspired in part by the legacy of classic adventure game Myst - did you know that Myst actually came with a notepad in the game box itself! You can see a cool image of someone's notes from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/retrogaming/comments/3ie556/ran_across_my_journal_of_myst_recently_and/]this fun Reddit thread![/url]

[h2]Last but not least...[/h2]
[previewyoutube=cjoAQOTGHQY;full][/previewyoutube]
We have a great announcement for console fans today - those of you following our social media might already have figured it out - the [i]We Were Here[/i] series is coming to PlayStation 4 soon! No dates yet, but we'll let you know whenever we have something firmed up. Follow our social media for all the latest news and [i]We Were Here[/i] developments! And don't forget: keep your eyes open, because we will probably have more hidden messages in the coming months...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/73f196befcd32d07da58aa034239395125aeaf6a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/73f196befcd32d07da58aa034239395125aeaf6a.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]Do you see the circle in this image? There were four other images that had a triangle, cross and square. Put them together, and you got the PS4 controller buttons![/i]

notes.title: Talking to you!
notes.content:
We have released an update for [i]We Were Here Too[/i], which brings a new voice chat system to the game. 

[h2]Agora voice chat implementation[/h2]
We have teamed up with Agora.io to bring you a new chat system! Our switch to the Agora voice chat system doesn't require anything from you as a player - but some people who had trouble with the previous system might find their walkie-talkies performing better now!

In case you missed it, our producer Geoff van den Ouden joined a V-Chat event hosted by Agora. You can catch up on YouTube. Topics included how the current restrictions brought on by COVID-19 are skyrocketing the demand for interactive gaming apps, a bit of personal backstory, and valuable tips to increase session times and user retention by adding live voice and video directly into their game. 

[previewyoutube=LJOSqTfmAdk;full][/previewyoutube]
The release of this update also means we are ending support for Linux and 32 bit versions of [i]We Were Here Too[/i]. You might have noticed this already happened for the other [i]We Were Here[/i] games. We know many people are still playing [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Too[/i] for the first time - we see people making screenshots, for instance! 

Like this recent one from player Parallel Platypus...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/982873c0d947b83b33aa84669e538037e9aa985f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30175181/982873c0d947b83b33aa84669e538037e9aa985f.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]This stained glass window is just one of many paintings, drawings, and stained glass scenes to find as you explore.[/i]

[b]Have a great day!
Total Mayhem Games[/b]

notes.title: We Were Here Together has been released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=XhE5mPCHdY4;full][/previewyoutube]
The sequel to [i]We Were Here Too[/i] is out now on Steam! Get it for $12.99 / €12.99. There is a launch discount of 5%, and all of you who own [i]We Were Here Too[/i] will get a 10% discount. The third game in the [i]We Were Here[/i] series features new gameplay mechanics, locations, and puzzles. In response to your requests, there is more emphasis on story than ever before, and several large environments to explore and solve puzzles within.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c3ea4f6faa8cb94657c38b8ad5ff709cf69c1024.png[/img][/url]
[i]Your adventure will start out at the base camp...[/i]

What’s new?
[list][*]Even closer coop – you won’t always be split up from your partner this time. Explore together, try both sides of a puzzle for a different perspective, it’s up to you! Just don’t get too comfortable - Castle Rock has some tricks waiting for you…
[*]The great outdoors – puzzle outside Castle Rock for the first time, from the deceptively cosy expedition base camp through imposing sub-zero valleys to breath-taking frozen caves.
[*]Gadgets won’t save you - but they might help! Figure out how to use new equipment and gather an inventory of curious items to solve puzzles and progress towards the fateful finale in [i]We Were Here Together[/i].
[*]You aren’t alone in Castle Rock – and this time you get to meet a fellow explorer who is trapped inside. Could they know a way out… and can you trust them?[/list] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/c45e7bb15ccd5d661462a012e98b780924805539.png[/img][/url]
[i]You will travel through the icy wastes...[/i]

At the start of the game, you and your partner will be able to walk around together, looking for clues and solving puzzles. There's an epic journey ahead of you, from the warmth of the base camp through the Antarctic wastes to the sinister Castle Rock. Inside, you'll get split up.

From then on, you and your partner will really have to test your communication skills to their limits, sharing your asymmetric perspectives to figure out puzzles together.  Keep your eyes open, keep talking, and you might just make it out in one piece.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/67daf72bbd9e49217cf26b969f50695c40c28ede.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/67daf72bbd9e49217cf26b969f50695c40c28ede.png[/img][/url]
[i]...and who knows where you'll end up?[/i]

For anyone who doesn’t have the complete collection yet, check out the We Were Here Series Bundle! It does what it says on the can, with all three games, two supporter editions, and every soundtrack in one tidy collection. That’s right, two supporter editions: the [i]We Were Here Together[/i] Supporter Edition contains a special walkie-talkie skin, beautiful artworks designed specially for desktop or phone backgrounds, and almost an hour of music!

More than 2,000,000 players on Steam have enjoyed [i]We Were Here[/i] and [i]We Were Here Too[/i] since their releases. We can't wait to see what people make of the latest game!

[h1]We hope you'll join us in meeting up [i]together[/i] for the third entry – We Were Here Together![/h1]

notes.title: We Were Here Too - Patch V.21022018
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I've got some new patch notes for you here, this also includes the issues we have fixed in the hotfix from last week.

[h1]Patch notes V.21022018– February 21th 2018[/h1]

[b][General][/b]
[list]
[*]We have changed some of our start up parameters to avoid resolution issues.
[*]Added the possibilty to rebind the movement keys (keyboard only).
[*]Updated some more names in the credits.
[*]Fixed save game related crashes.
[/list]

[b][Gamepad][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some issues while navigating the menus with a gamepad.
[*]The pawn on the battleboard no longer loses focus after completing a stage.
[*]Gamepad rebinding should now work as intended. (Revert to default will show the buttons again).
[/list]

[b][Ending][/b]
[list]
[*]Dying and respawning with all secret levers pulled will now work correctly.
[/list]

[b][Save Game][/b]
[list]
[*]Moved the Config.cfg to a public folder to avoid permission issues.
[/list]

The file can now be found in the following location.
[b]Windows: [/b]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Total Mayhem Games\We Were Here Too\Config
[b]OSX: [/b]~/Library/Application Support/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
[b]Linux: [/b]$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/unity3d/Total Mayhem Games/We Were Here Too/Config
Expect the old folder/file to be removed in a future update.

[b]Video Issue[/b]
We've been trying to reproduce the issue on our systems without luck, however we have made some changes to the code based on the videos and reports we have collected on the forums. Please let us know if the issue has been resolved.

If you are still experiencing any issues i encourage you to join the discussions here on steam!

Thanks again for all of your feedback.

We've been trying to reproduce the issue on our systems without luck, however we have made some changes to the code based on the videos and reports we have collected on the forums. Please let us know if the issue has been resolved.

If you are still experiencing any issues i encourage you to join the discussions here on steam!

Thanks again for all of your feedback.

notes.title: We Were Here Too - Patch V.09022018
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Let me start off with thanking you guys for hunting down and reporting some issues you may have encountered! Let's take a look at what today's patch has in store for our explorers.

[h1]Patch notes V.09022018 – February 9th 2018[/h1]

[b][The Stairwell][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue with occlusion culling when standing in certain spots
[*]Rebalanced the amount of time remaining on a wrong solution
[/list]

[b][The Arena][/b][list]
[*]Rebalanced the time available between some of the objectives
[/list]

[b][The Elevator][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the rotating wheel when a controller was plugged in
[/list]

[b][General][/b][list]
[*]Fixed alot of minor things that would make this list [i]too[/i] big!
[*]Players can now select a region to connect with. 
     [i]Please look for the dropdown menu in the top-right when searching or creating a new game and select the region with the best ping for you[/i]
[*]Increased the spacing between the lobbies when searching for a game
[*]Restarting from a checkpoint after a game over should now synchronize properly between players
[*]Resolved an issue with voice chat on the game over screen
[*]Improved voice chat
     [i]We managed to crack some bugs and issues, thanks for reporting them![/i]
[*]Improved readability of the text on some of the books found around the game
[*]Added some missing names to the credits
     [i]Sorry![/i]
[/list]

We'll keep on improving our user experience with patches. Thanks again for all of your feedback and we hope you enjoy your time cooperating!
